warnings: Type schedule with a printed จำนวน (count) per type — count is the printed number. Marks kept as printed (ป = door, น = window).

Widths: where two widths are printed (1.00/0.90, 0.90/0.80, 0.80/0.70) the outer one is the frame (width_m) and the inner one the leaf (leaf_width_m). Every door is 2.05 high to ระดับพื้นห้อง; window heights are the printed sill + window stack.
ป1 is printed ประตูบานเปิด but drawn as two FIX side lights and two hinged leaves in one 2.20 frame — panel_note records the drawing.
